name: Wooden Churches of Maramureş
description: Eight timber churches are scattered through the villages of Maramureş, in the mountains of northern Romania. Built from thick logs between the 17th and 19th centuries, each is crowned by a needle-slim shingled tower and a steep roof that seems to dwarf the walls below. Step inside the small, dim interiors to find walls covered in naïve, folk-style paintings of Biblical scenes.
